results.title: Bloomberg Terminals: How Much More You'll Pay Next Year
results.content:
Treasury and finance teams and anyone else who considers the Bloomberg Terminal a must-have tool will pay 6.5% more for two-year subscriptions that begin or renew on or after Jan. 1, 2025. In a letter to customers, the company said, “Consistent with Bloomberg’s historical practice, our price increase is linked to weighted global inflation over the prior two-year period.”

- The monthly charge for Bloomberg clients with more than one Terminal will rise next year to $2,360. That amounts to $28,320 a year, compared to $26,580 now, following a 9.6% jump in 2023 . The annual cost for users with one Terminal will rise to $31,980.

- The 6.5% increase for 2025 also applies to Bloomberg data licenses and real-time data service offerings. The latter include the Bloomberg Market Data Feed , known as B-PIPE.

results.content: While its distinctive black screen is austere and has graphics more reminiscent of early aughts web surfing than ready-for-your-VR headset, it’s the weapon of choice for institutional investors, portfolio managers, and financial analysts worldwide. The annual subscription fee for a single Bloomberg terminal is just under $32,000 as of 2026, with the price dropping to $28,320 if you have multiple units.

results.title: Bloomberg Terminal Cost 2026: About $32,000 per User a Year
results.content:
## How much does a Bloomberg Terminal cost?

A Bloomberg Terminal costs $31,980 per year for a single user and $28,320 per user per year at sites with two or more seats, according to Bloomberg's letter to customers about its January 2025 increase, as reported by NeuGroup. Subscriptions run on two-year contracts, so the commitment is roughly $64,000 for one user and $56,640 per seat for larger teams.

| | Single seat | Per seat, 2 or more seats |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Annual price (2025 and 2026) | $31,980 | $28,320 |
| Monthly equivalent | $2,665 | $2,360 |
| Commitment over a two-year term | $63,960 | $56,640 per seat |

A further increase has been reported by ZeroHedge, citing a Bloomberg email, for contracts that start or renew from 1 January 2027. Bloomberg has not published new prices, and the final price on any contract is negotiated.

...

- January 2023: a 9.6%

...

- January 2025: a 6.5% increase for two-year terms starting or renewing from 1 January 2025, taking the multi-seat price from $26,580 to $28,320 per seat. The same letter covered Bloomberg's data products, B-PIPE and Data License, which are priced separately from the Terminal.
- January 2027 (reported): a further increase for contracts that start or renew from 1 January 2027 (ZeroHedge).

results.title: Bloomberg Terminal Cost in 2026: $31,980 a Year
results.content:
A single Bloomberg Terminal costs $31,980 a year in 2026, or $28,320 a terminal on a multi-terminal subscription. Here is what that buys, what it still leaves to your analysts, and when it is worth it.

By Aaryan Saroha, Founder and CEO · Published 31 August 2026 · Updated 27 September 2026 · 3 min read

$31,980 a year for one terminal, which is $2,665 a month, and $28,320 a year for each terminal on a multi-terminal subscription, which is $2,360 a month. Bloomberg sells two-year subscriptions and does not publish a rate card, so your contract can differ.

...

Bloomberg raised the monthly price of two-year subscriptions by 6.5% for renewals from 1 January 2025, saying the increase is “linked to weighted global inflation over the prior two-year period” [1]. That took a single terminal to $31,980 a year and a multi-terminal seat from $26,580 to $28,320. Pricing trackers still showed $31,980 in August 2026 [2].

| Seats | Rate | Per year | Two-year term |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | $2,665 a month | $31,980 | $63,960 |
| 3 | $2,360 a month each | $84,960 | $169,920 |
| 5 | $2,360 a month each | $141,600 | $283,200 |
| 10 | $2,360 a month each | $283,200 | $566,400 |

These are the rates reported for 2025 renewals, before any negotiated discount or additional data licences.

results.title: Bloomberg Terminal Pricing 2026: What a Single Seat Actually Costs | Market Intelligence Tools
results.content:
The numbers Bloomberg terminal pricing, checked 15 August 2026

$31,980 Single-seat annual renewal, effective on or after 1 Jan 2025 NeuGroup, 9 Oct 2024

$28,320 Per-seat annual renewal at two or more terminals, up from $26,580 NeuGroup, 9 Oct 2024

...

NeuGroup's 9 October 2024 report described the notice Bloomberg sent corporate treasury clients: a terminal would renew at $31,980 a year from 1 January 2025, with firms holding two or more terminals paying $28,320 each. Bloomberg attributed the rise from the prior $26,580 rate to weighted global inflation.

...

1. The base subscription: $31,980 for one seat, or $28,320 a seat from two up.

...

Setup, $500 to $1,500 per terminal on a new installation.

...

Hardware upkeep, $200 to $500 a year per terminal.
4. Any enterprise data licence, from $10,000 upward, plus API charges where a system pulls the feed directly.

A single new terminal with hardware and setup lands near $33,000 in year one and near $32,300 after that. Two terminals land near $58,000 a year at the multi-seat rate before add-ons. Neither figure includes a data licence, which is where a quote stops being predictable, and money doesn't grow on trees once that line item lands.
